authority.main_agent: The main agent remains accountable for integration, review, tests, PR posture, wiki publication, merge readiness, and final communication.
authority.source_truth: Delegation records summarize work posture and never replace GitHub, repository files, task-ledger artifacts, validators, or test results as source truth.
authority.review: Delegated output is evidence, not review. Returned implementation work must be reviewed before commit, push, or closure evidence.
authority.write_scope: Implementation and documentation delegation require explicit bounded write_scope. No-write profiles must declare write_scope as none.

invariants: Delegation has one accountable main agent.
Delegation output is evidence and not review.
Implementation and documentation delegation require explicit bounded write_scope.
No-write profiles must declare write_scope as none.
Delegated workers must not revert unrelated work.
Delegated workers must not merge PRs or publish wiki without main-agent review.
LOST delegated work is an operational finding.
Heartbeat reads task-ledger truth and must not inspect hidden model state.
